envFailure is undefined for a pass and an ordinary test failure, and names the code, signal or loader phrase
checkAllows expands a compound check into the segments OpenCode checks, env assignments stripped
a check that cannot run (command not found) stops after one worker run: no fixes, no escalation
the worker sees the uncommitted plan, uncommitted edits and untracked files; job creation leaves the checkout alone
dependency directories are linked into the worktree, never diffed or landed, and unlinked afterwards
a dependency dir the repo already gitignores is not named in add's pathspec (git 2.55 rejects it)
a directory-only gitignore rule leaves the worktree's dependency symlink unignored, so it is still excluded
a failed job keeps its worktree with the dependency link in place
link_dirs is configurable in cheapag.json
build output is never linked: a link_dirs entry naming it is a config error
worker edits to files the developer had not committed yet (incl. the plan) land
a committed dependency dir is not linked, and worker edits inside it land
an untracked nested repository is left out of the worktree and does not break the job
delegating with a rebase in the checkout is refused before any job starts
delegating with unresolved conflicts without a merge (a conflicted stash pop) in the checkout is refused before any job starts
delegating during an in-progress merge is refused before any job starts
a repository with no commits yet is refused before any job starts
